rules.title: Recurring schedules
rules.hint: Every recurring series lives here, including ones that have ended or not started yet — the ones that produce no sessions in the week you are looking at.
rules.openNext: Open the next session in week view

week.clickToAdd: Click an empty slot to add an event
week.dragHint: Drop to move · Esc to cancel

month.openDay: Open this day in week view

list.searchPlaceholder: Accents optional: gia su, dai hoc…

category.title: Category
category.manageHint: Categories set the colour on the calendar and whether a session counts towards income.
category.name: Category name
category.incomeEligibleHint: Turn this off and every session in this category earns zero, even ones with their own rate. Bonuses and penalties for the month are ignored too.
category.turningOffWarning: {{n}} records in this category carry a rate. Turning this off stops them earning, but the data stays — switch it back on and the numbers return.
category.defaultRateHint: Used when a session has no rate of its own.
category.deleteMessage: Schedules and events under “{{name}}” move to “Uncategorised”. Pay settings and adjustments for this category are hidden. Press Undo on the toast and everything comes back.
category.cannotDeleteSystem: The system category cannot be deleted

event.title: Title
event.titlePlaceholder: Morning shift, Calculus II, tutoring Minh…
event.longDurationWarning: This session is {{hours}} hours long. The End field takes wall-clock time, so {{endTime}} means the NEXT day. If you meant a time within the same day, fix it.
event.clientHint: Leave empty if this is not a teaching session.
event.noIncomeCategory: Category “{{name}}” does not count towards income, so there is no money field here. Change it on the Manage screen if needed.

money.fixedHint: This amount is NOT multiplied by hours — use it for flat-fee sessions.

scope.occurrenceHint: Writes one exception. Every other session in the series stays as it is.
scope.followingHint: Splits the series in two. Past sessions stay untouched, so closed payroll months do not shift.
scope.seriesHint: Changes sessions that already happened too. The series start date does NOT follow the Date field above.

recurrence.lockedHint: Scope “this session only” cannot change the repeat rule.
recurrence.dayOfMonthHint: Months without this day are skipped — picking 31 means February gets no session at all.

detail.fixedMonthlyHint: This job pays a fixed monthly salary, so a single session has no meaningful value on its own. The official figure lives on the Income screen.

salary.modePickHint: Pick a mode. There is no default — the same data under the two modes differs by a large margin.
salary.modeHourlyHint: Pay = hours worked × rate. Miss a session, lose that session's pay.
salary.modeFixedHint: The same salary every month regardless of session count — unless you choose to deduct for missing hours below.
salary.mustPickShortfall: Choose what happens when hours fall short
salary.standardHoursHint: For example 176. Used to derive an hourly rate for shortfall deductions and overtime.
salary.standardHoursRequired: Standard hours must be greater than 0 when using shortfall deduction or an overtime multiplier
salary.shortfallNoneHint: A true fixed salary. Approved leave still pays the full month.
salary.shortfallProRataHint: Each missing hour is deducted at the rate derived from monthly salary ÷ standard hours.
salary.effectiveToHint: Leave empty to keep it current. When pay changes, add a new record instead of editing the old one.
salary.overtimeHint: For example 1.5. Applies to hours beyond the standard. Leave empty for no overtime.
salary.nightShiftHint: Only the hours falling inside the night window are multiplied. A window crossing midnight (22:00 → 06:00) is handled correctly.
salary.noEligibleCategory: No category counts towards income yet. Go to Manage and turn on “Counts towards income” first.

adjustment.title: Adjustments
adjustment.amountHint: Enter a positive number. The type decides whether it adds or subtracts — this field rejects minus signs.
adjustment.label: Reason
adjustment.labelHint: Be specific so it still makes sense months later.
adjustment.saveTemplateHint: Next time one click recreates this, no retyping the amount.
adjustment.applyTemplate: Click to add this to the month you are viewing

payroll.projectionNote: The figure beside this includes hours that have not happened yet. Mark sessions as completed to keep it closer to reality.
payroll.mixedCurrency: These jobs use different currencies, so they cannot be summed. See each one below.
payroll.unconfiguredWarning: Some jobs have no pay settings. Without them the system assumes hourly, and with no rate anywhere the result is zero.
payroll.noEligibleCategory: No job counts towards income yet.
payroll.noEligibleHint: Go to Manage and turn on “Counts towards income” for your job.
payroll.negativeWarning: Take-home is negative — check the deductions you entered. The system deliberately does NOT clamp this to zero, because clamping hides data-entry mistakes.

settings.hint: Settings live in this browser and do not sync to other machines.
settings.themeHint: Printouts always use black on white, even when the screen is in dark mode.
settings.languageHint: Changes interface text only. Titles, notes and student names are your own data and stay exactly as you typed them.
settings.weekStartsOnHint: Only changes column order on screen. Existing repeat rules are unaffected.
settings.currencyHint: Used when a job has no currency of its own.
settings.autoComplete: Mark past sessions as completed automatically
settings.autoCompleteHint: Sessions that ended before now count as attended unless you set another status. Turn it off to mark each one by hand.
settings.showConflictsHint: Shows ⚠ on overlapping sessions. A warning only, never a block — sometimes you overlap on purpose.

stats.conflictsHint: Open the List screen and filter by overlap to see them.
stats.autoCompleteCaveat: “Mark past sessions as completed automatically” is on, so every past session counts as done and this rate always looks good. For a figure that reflects reality, turn that option off in Settings and mark sessions yourself.

trash.title: Trash
trash.why: Every delete in this app is a soft delete — the record stays so Undo has somewhere to go back to. Once the Undo toast disappears, they land here.
trash.purgeOneMessage: “{{label}}” will be removed from the database. There is no Undo for this.
trash.purgeOldMessage: {{n}} records deleted more than {{days}} days ago will be gone for good. There is no Undo for this. Export a backup first if you are unsure.
trash.categoryCaveat: Restoring a category brings back only the category itself. Its schedules and events moved to “Uncategorised” when it was deleted and do not return on their own — only the Undo button at the moment of deletion can do that.

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.why: All your data lives in this one browser's IndexedDB. Clearing browsing data, reinstalling the machine, or switching browser loses everything — no server keeps a copy. Export regularly and store the file elsewhere.
backup.unknownTables: The file has tables this version does not know about ({{tables}}). Those will not be imported.
backup.modeMergeHint: Keeps everything you have. For records with the same id, the more recently edited one wins. Nothing is deleted.
backup.modeReplaceHint: Wipes current data and restores from the file. The result matches the moment of export.
backup.noUndoWarning: There is no Undo for this. If you are unsure, export a backup of your current data first.
backup.errorNotJson: The file is not valid JSON.
backup.errorNotObject: The file contents are not in the expected shape.
backup.errorWrongFormat: This is not a backup file from this app.
backup.errorMissingData: The file has no data block.
backup.errorNewerSchema: This file came from a newer version. Importing it would drop fields this version does not know — update the app first.
backup.errorTableNotArray: The data structure in the file is broken.

validation.effectiveToBeforeFrom: The end month cannot be before the start month
validation.pickWeekday: Pick at least one day of the week
validation.dayOfMonthRange: Day of month must be between 1 and 31
validation.endDateAfterStart: The end date cannot be before the start date
validation.countPositive: Session count must be greater than 0

toast.seriesSplit: Split the series from this session onwards
